copy.tagline: 为 acme-versioned CLI 编写自定义命令
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果你需要扩展 acme-versioned CLI 的功能
copy.tagline_en: Write custom commands for the acme-versioned CLI
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you need to extend the acme-versioned CLI

howto.what: 安装后，Claude能指导你为 acme-versioned CLI 编写自定义命令。自定义命令自动继承 CLI 的认证、重试等配置，无需额外设置。
howto.when: 当你想扩展 acme-versioned CLI 的功能，比如添加新命令或修改 custom.rs 文件时触发。

say.text: 如何在 acme-versioned 中创建一个自定义命令并调用 v1 API？
say.note: Claude会展示代码示例和调用方式。

howto.what_en: After installation, Claude can guide you to author custom commands for the acme-versioned CLI. Custom commands automatically inherit the CLI's auth, retry, TLS settings, etc., with zero configuration.
howto.when_en: When you want to extend the acme-versioned CLI by adding a new custom command or editing the custom.rs file.

say_en.text: Help me add a new command called my-command to acme-versioned.
say_en.note: Claude will guide you to edit custom.rs and register the command.

say_en.text: How do I create a custom command in acme-versioned that calls a v1 API?
say_en.note: Claude will show code examples and invocation.
